name: BYINTEK T5 Max
summary: BYINTEK T5 Max ships with telemetry, ads and unused stick apps. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: The BYINTEK T5 Max projector has a built-in Google TV stick with telemetry and remote management on it. It also has ad and personalization services, factory test apps and extra apps that make no sense on a projector stick. The list has 18 apps.

The setup wizard was left on, because it holds the saved Wi-Fi network and turning it off would drop the projector off Wi-Fi. TidyTV leaves it on. It turns the rest off over Wi-Fi with a backup first, and the projector hardware is not touched. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The setup wizard, which owns the saved Wi-Fi network
The projector's autofocus, keystone and HDMI switching
Google Play Store and Play Services
notes: Autofocus, keystone and HDMI switching are run by the projector's own mainboard, not by this stick, so TidyTV cannot touch them.

faq.a: Yes. The setup wizard holds the saved network, so TidyTV leaves it on.

faq.q: Will autofocus and keystone still work?
faq.a: Yes. They are run by the projector's mainboard, not the Google TV stick, and TidyTV does not touch them.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on in one tap.
